title: Oath of the Gatewatch/Intro packs
description: MTG Wiki (Category:Battle for Zendikar block intro packs)

paragraphs.text: Oath of the Gatewatch has five intro packs :
Desperate Stand is a intro pack centering around Ally Zendikari and the Rally and Cohort mechanic.
Munda's Vanguard is the representative foil rare and Drana's Chosen is the second rare of this pack.
Twisted Reality is a intro pack centering around Eldrazi , colorless mana cost , Wastes and the Devoid mechanic.
Deepfathom Skulker is the representative foil rare and Endless One is the second rare of this pack.
Vicious Cycle is a intro pack centering around creature token production and sacrificing creatures for various effects.
Dread Defiler is the representative foil rare and Smothering Abomination is the second rare of this pack.
Surge of Resistance is a intro pack centering around the surge mechanic and dealing damage fast either due to Flying , Haste or direct damage .
Tyrant of Valakut is the representative foil rare and Ugin's Insight is the second rare of this pack.
Concerted Effort is a intro pack centering around creature token production, supporting them with +1/+1 counters and having many of them on the battlefield .
Gladehart Cavalry is the representative foil rare and Veteran Warleader is the second rare of this pack.
